verses.textZh: 大利乌王第二年六月一日，耶和华的话借着哈该先知临到撒拉铁的儿子、犹大省长所罗巴伯，和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利乌王第二年六月一日，耶和华的话借着哈该先知临到撒拉铁的儿子、犹大省长所罗巴伯，和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 大流士王第二年六月初一日，耶和华的话藉先知哈该向犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the second year of King Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest:
verses.textEnEsv: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came by the hand of Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest:
verses.textEnNkjv: In the second year of King Darius, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: On August 29 of the second year of King Darius’s reign, the Lord gave a message through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Jeshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
verses.textEnNasb: In the second year of Darius the king, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the Lord came by the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
verses.textEn: In the second year of King Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest:

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘这民说，重建耶和华殿宇的时候还没有到。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘这民说，重建耶和华殿宇的时候还没有到。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：「这百姓说，建造耶和华殿的时候尚未来到。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the Lord ’s house.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: These people say the time has not yet come to rebuild the house of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus speaks the Lord of hosts, saying: ‘This people says, "The time has not come, the time that the Lord’s house should be built." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: The people are saying, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the house of the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord of armies says: ‘This people says, "The time has not come, the time for the house of the Lord to be rebuilt." ’ "
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the Lord ’s house.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是，耶和华的话临到哈该先知说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，耶和华的话临到哈该先知说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那时耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came by the hand of Haggai the prophet,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord sent this message through the prophet Haggai:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai:

verses.textZh: "这殿宇仍然荒废，岂是你们住在有天花板的房屋的时候吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "这殿宇仍然荒废，岂是你们住在有天花板的房屋的时候吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 「这殿仍然荒凉，你们自己还住天花板的房屋吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Is it a time for you yourselves to be living in your paneled houses, while this house remains a ruin?"
verses.textEnEsv: "Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies in ruins?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Isit time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, and this temple tolie in ruins?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why are you living in luxurious houses while my house lies in ruins?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it time for you yourselves to live in your paneled houses while this house remains desolate?"
verses.textEn: "Is it a time for you yourselves to be living in your paneled houses, while this house remains a ruin?"

verses.textZh: 现在万军之耶和华这样说："你们要反省自己的行为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在万军之耶和华这样说："你们要反省自己的行为。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在万军之耶和华如此说：你们要省察自己的行为。
verses.textEnNiv: Now this is what the Lord Almighty says: "Give careful thought to your ways.
verses.textEnEsv: Now, therefore, thus says the Lord of hosts: Consider your ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, thus says the Lord of hosts: "Consider your ways!
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: Look at what’s happening to you!
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, the Lord of armies says this: " Consider your ways!
verses.textEn: Now this is what the Lord Almighty says: "Give careful thought to your ways.

verses.textZh: 你们撒的种多，收割的却少；你们吃，却吃不饱；你们喝，却喝不足；你们穿衣服，却穿不暖；得工钱的，却把工钱放在破袋里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们撒的种多，收割的却少；你们吃，却吃不饱；你们喝，却喝不足；你们穿衣服，却穿不暖；得工钱的，却把工钱放在破袋里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们撒的种多，收的却少；你们吃，却不得饱；喝，却不得足；穿衣服，却不得暖；得工钱的，将工钱装在破漏的囊中。」
verses.textEnNiv: You have planted much, but harvested little. You eat, but never have enough. You drink, but never have your fill. You put on clothes, but are not warm. You earn wages, only to put them in a purse with holes in it."
verses.textEnEsv: You have sown much, and harvested little. You eat, but you never have enough; you drink, but you never have your fill. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm. And he who earns wages does so to put them into a bag with holes.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You have sown much, and bring in little; You eat, but do not have enough; You drink, but you are not filled with drink; You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; And he who earns wages, Earns wages toput into a bag with holes."
verses.textEnNlt: You have planted much but harvest little. You eat but are not satisfied. You drink but are still thirsty. You put on clothes but cannot keep warm. Your wages disappear as though you were putting them in pockets filled with holes!
verses.textEnNasb: You have sown much, only to harvest little; you eat, but there is not enough to be satisfied; you drink, but there is not enough to become drunk; you put on clothing, but there is not enough for anyone to get warm; and the one who earns, earns wages to put into a money bag full of holes."
verses.textEn: You have planted much, but harvested little. You eat, but never have enough. You drink, but never have your fill. You put on clothes, but are not warm. You earn wages, only to put them in a purse with holes in it."

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华这样说："你们要反省自己的行为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华这样说："你们要反省自己的行为。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你们要省察自己的行为。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Give careful thought to your ways.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: Consider your ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Consider your ways!
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: Look at what’s happening to you!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies says this: " Consider your ways!
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Give careful thought to your ways.

verses.textZh: 你们要上山取木材，建造殿宇；我必因此喜悦，并且得荣耀。"耶和华说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要上山取木材，建造殿宇；我必因此喜悦，并且得荣耀。"耶和华说：
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要上山取木料，建造这殿，我就因此喜乐，且得荣耀。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Go up into the mountains and bring down timber and build my house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be honored," says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Go up to the hills and bring wood and build the house, that I may take pleasure in it and that I may be glorified, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Go up to the mountains and bring wood and build the temple, that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Now go up into the hills, bring down timber, and rebuild my house. Then I will take pleasure in it and be honored, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Go up to the mountains, bring wood, and rebuild the temple, that I may be pleased with it and be honored," says the Lord.
verses.textEn: Go up into the mountains and bring down timber and build my house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be honored," says the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们期望丰收，反倒歉收；你们收到家里的，我就吹去。"为甚么呢？万军之耶和华说："因为我的殿宇荒废，你们各人却为自己的房屋奔驰。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们期望丰收，反倒歉收；你们收到家里的，我就吹去。"为甚么呢？万军之耶和华说："因为我的殿宇荒废，你们各人却为自己的房屋奔驰。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们盼望多得，所得的却少；你们收到家中，我就吹去。这是为什么呢？因为我的殿荒凉，你们各人却顾 自己的房屋。这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "You expected much, but see, it turned out to be little. What you brought home, I blew away. Why?" declares the Lord Almighty. "Because of my house, which remains a ruin, while each of you is busy with your own house.
verses.textEnEsv: You looked for much, and behold, it came to little. And when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why? declares the Lord of hosts. Because of my house that lies in ruins, while each of you busies himself with his own house.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You looked for much, but indeed itcameto little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?" says the Lord of hosts. "Because of My house that isin ruins, while every one of you runs to his own house.
verses.textEnNlt: You hoped for rich harvests, but they were poor. And when you brought your harvest home, I blew it away. Why? Because my house lies in ruins, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, while all of you are busy building your own fine houses.
verses.textEnNasb: "You start an ambitious project, but behold, it comes to little; when you bring it home, I blow it away. Why?" declares the Lord of armies. "It is because of My house which remains desolate, while each of you runs to his own house.
verses.textEn: "You expected much, but see, it turned out to be little. What you brought home, I blew away. Why?" declares the Lord Almighty. "Because of my house, which remains a ruin, while each of you is busy with your own house.

verses.textZh: 所以，因你们的缘故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，因你们的缘故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土产。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以为你们的缘故，天就不降甘露，地也不出土产。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, because of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth its crops.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the heavens above you have withheld the dew, and the earth has withheld its produce.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the heavens above you withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: It’s because of you that the heavens withhold the dew and the earth produces no crops.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, because of you the sky has withheld its dew, and the earth has withheld its produce.
verses.textEn: Therefore, because of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth its crops.

verses.textZh: 我叫干旱临到大地、群山、五谷、新酒、新油、地上的出产、人畜和人手劳碌得来的一切。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我叫干旱临到大地、群山、五谷、新酒、新油、地上的出产、人畜和人手劳碌得来的一切。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我命干旱临到地土、山冈、五谷、新酒，和油，并地上的出产、人民、牲畜，以及人手一切劳碌得来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I called for a drought on the fields and the mountains, on the grain, the new wine, the olive oil and everything else the ground produces, on people and livestock, and on all the labor of your hands."
verses.textEnEsv: And I have called for a drought on the land and the hills, on the grain, the new wine, the oil, on what the ground brings forth, on man and beast, and on all their labors."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I called for a drought on the land and the mountains, on the grain and the new wine and the oil, on whatever the ground brings forth, on men and livestock, and on all the labor of your hands."
verses.textEnNlt: I have called for a drought on your fields and hills—a drought to wither the grain and grapes and olive trees and all your other crops, a drought to starve you and your livestock and to ruin everything you have worked so hard to get."
verses.textEnNasb: And I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on what the ground produces, on mankind, on cattle, and on all the products of the labor of your hands."
verses.textEn: I called for a drought on the fields and the mountains, on the grain, the new wine, the olive oil and everything else the ground produces, on people and livestock, and on all the labor of your hands."

verses.textZh: 那时，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯、约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚和所有余剩的子民，都听从了耶和华他们神的话，听从了耶和华他们神所差来的哈该先知的话。众民在耶和华面前都存着敬畏的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯、约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚和所有余剩的子民，都听从了耶和华他们神的话，听从了耶和华他们神所差来的哈该先知的话。众民在耶和华面前都存着敬畏的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下的百姓，都听从耶和华－他们神的话和先知哈该奉耶和华－他们神差来所说的话；百姓也在耶和华面前存敬畏的心。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the whole remnant of the people obeyed the voice of the Lord their God and the message of the prophet Haggai, because the Lord their God had sent him. And the people feared the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the Lord their God had sent him. And the people feared the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the Lord their God had sent him; and the people feared the presence of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the whole remnant of God’s people began to obey the message from the Lord their God. When they heard the words of the prophet Haggai, whom the Lord their God had sent, the people feared the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God and the words of Haggai the prophet, just as the Lord their God had sent him. And the people showed reverence for the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the whole remnant of the people obeyed the voice of the Lord their God and the message of the prophet Haggai, because the Lord their God had sent him. And the people feared the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者哈该，奉耶和华的命，对众民说："耶和华说：‘我与你们同在。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者哈该，奉耶和华的命，对众民说："耶和华说：‘我与你们同在。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者哈该奉耶和华差遣对百姓说：「耶和华说：我与你们同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Haggai, the Lord ’s messenger, gave this message of the Lord to the people: "I am with you," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then Haggai, the messenger of the Lord , spoke to the people with the Lord ’s message, "I am with you, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Haggai, the Lord’s messenger, spoke the Lord’s message to the people, saying, "I am with you, says the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Haggai, the Lord ’s messenger, gave the people this message from the Lord : "I am with you, says the Lord !"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Haggai, the messenger of the Lord, spoke by the commission of the Lord to the people, saying, " ‘I am with you,’ declares the Lord."
verses.textEn: Then Haggai, the Lord ’s messenger, gave this message of the Lord to the people: "I am with you," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华激发了撒拉铁的儿子、犹大省长所罗巴伯的心，和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚的心，以及所有余剩子民的心，他们就来兴工建造万军之耶和华他们神的殿宇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华激发了撒拉铁的儿子、犹大省长所罗巴伯的心，和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚的心，以及所有余剩子民的心，他们就来兴工建造万军之耶和华他们神的殿宇。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华激动犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下之百姓的心，他们就来为万军之耶和华－他们神的殿做工。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the whole remnant of the people. They came and began to work on the house of the Lord Almighty, their God,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people. And they came and worked on the house of the Lord of hosts, their God,
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the Lord of hosts, their God,
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord sparked the enthusiasm of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the enthusiasm of Jeshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the enthusiasm of the whole remnant of God’s people. They began to work on the house of their God, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies,
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the Lord of armies, their God,
verses.textEn: So the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the whole remnant of the people. They came and began to work on the house of the Lord Almighty, their God,

verses.textZh: 那时是大利乌王第二年六月二十四日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时是大利乌王第二年六月二十四日。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是在大流士王第二年六月二十四日。
verses.textEnNiv: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month. In the second year of King Darius,
verses.textEnEsv: on the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.
verses.textEnNlt: on September 21 of the second year of King Darius’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of Darius the king.
verses.textEn: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month. In the second year of King Darius,

verses.textZh: 七月二十一日，耶和华的话临到哈该先知说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 七月二十一日，耶和华的话临到哈该先知说：
verses.textZhCuv: 七月二十一日，耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：
verses.textEnNiv: on the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai:
verses.textEnEsv: In the seventh month, on the twenty-first day of the month, the word of the Lord came by the hand of Haggai the prophet:
verses.textEnNkjv: In the seventh month, on the twenty-first of the month, the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then on October 17 of that same year, the Lord sent another message through the prophet Haggai.
verses.textEnNasb: On the twenty-first of the seventh month, the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.textEn: on the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai:

verses.textZh: "你要对撒拉铁的儿子犹大省长所罗巴伯，和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，以及所有余剩的子民，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要对撒拉铁的儿子犹大省长所罗巴伯，和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，以及所有余剩的子民，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要晓谕犹大省长撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯和约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚，并剩下的百姓，说：
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people. Ask them,
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to all the remnant of the people, and say,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: "Say this to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Jeshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of God’s people there in the land:
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
verses.textEn: "Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people. Ask them,

verses.textZh: ‘你们中间剩下的人，有谁见过这殿宇从前的荣耀呢？现在你们又看它怎样？岂不是视如无物一样吗？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你们中间剩下的人，有谁见过这殿宇从前的荣耀呢？现在你们又看它怎样？岂不是视如无物一样吗？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们中间存留的，有谁见过这殿从前的荣耀呢？现在你们看着如何？岂不在眼中看如无有吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Who of you is left who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not seem to you like nothing?
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Is it not as nothing in your eyes?
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Who is left among you who saw this temple in its former glory? And how do you see it now? In comparison with it, isthis not in your eyes as nothing?
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Does anyone remember this house—this Temple—in its former splendor? How, in comparison, does it look to you now? It must seem like nothing at all!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Who is left among you who saw this temple in its former glory? And how do you see it now? Does it not seem to you like nothing in comparison?
verses.textEn: ‘Who of you is left who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not seem to you like nothing?

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："所罗巴伯啊！现在你要刚强。"耶和华说："约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚啊！你要刚强；这地的一切子民啊！你们也要刚强，并且要作工。"万军之耶和华说："因为我与你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："所罗巴伯啊！现在你要刚强。"耶和华说："约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚啊！你要刚强；这地的一切子民啊！你们也要刚强，并且要作工。"万军之耶和华说："因为我与你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「所罗巴伯啊，虽然如此，你当刚强！约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚啊，你也当刚强！这地的百姓，你们都当刚强做工，因为我与你们同在。这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: But now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ declares the Lord . ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ declares the Lord , ‘and work. For I am with you,’ declares the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, declares the Lord . Be strong, O Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land, declares the Lord . Work, for I am with you, declares the Lord of hosts,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the Lord; ‘and be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the Lord, ‘and work; for I am with you,’ says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: But now the Lord says: Be strong, Zerubbabel. Be strong, Jeshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people still left in the land. And now get to work, for I am with you, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: But now take courage, Zerubbabel,’ declares the Lord, ‘take courage also, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all you people of the land take courage,’ declares the Lord, ‘and work; for I am with you,’ declares the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: But now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ declares the Lord . ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ declares the Lord , ‘and work. For I am with you,’ declares the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 这就是你们从埃及出来的时候，我与你们立约的话。现在我的灵住在你们中间；你们不要惧怕。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是你们从埃及出来的时候，我与你们立约的话。现在我的灵住在你们中间；你们不要惧怕。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这是照着你们出埃及我与你们立约的话。那时，我的灵住在你们中间，你们不要惧怕。」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘This is what I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt. And my Spirit remains among you. Do not fear.’
verses.textEnEsv: according to the covenant that I made with you when you came out of Egypt. My Spirit remains in your midst. Fear not.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Accordingto the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, so My Spirit remains among you; do not fear!’
verses.textEnNlt: My Spirit remains among you, just as I promised when you came out of Egypt. So do not be afraid.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘As for the promise which I made you when you came out of Egypt, My Spirit remains in your midst; do not fear!’
verses.textEn: ‘This is what I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt. And my Spirit remains among you. Do not fear.’

verses.textZh: 因为万军之耶和华这样说："再过不多的时候，我要震动天、地、海洋和旱地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万军之耶和华这样说："再过不多的时候，我要震动天、地、海洋和旱地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：「过不多时，我必再一次震动天地、沧海，与旱地。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘In a little while I will once more shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord of hosts: Yet once more, in a little while, I will shake the heavens and the earth and the sea and the dry land.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Once more (it is a little while) I will shake heaven and earth, the sea and dry land;
verses.textEnNlt: "For this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: In just a little while I will again shake the heavens and the earth, the oceans and the dry land.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord of armies says: ‘Once more in a little while, I am going to shake the heavens and the earth, the sea also and the dry land.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘In a little while I will once more shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华说："我要震动万国，万国的珍宝就必运来；我要使这殿宇充满荣耀。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华说："我要震动万国，万国的珍宝就必运来；我要使这殿宇充满荣耀。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必震动万国；万国的珍宝必都运来 ，我就使这殿满了荣耀。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will shake all nations, and what is desired by all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory,’ says the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will shake all nations, so that the treasures of all nations shall come in, and I will fill this house with glory, says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: and I will shake all nations, and they shall come to the Desire of All Nations, and I will fill this temple with glory,’ says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: I will shake all the nations, and the treasures of all the nations will be brought to this Temple. I will fill this place with glory, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: I will shake all the nations; and they will come with the wealth of all nations, and I will fill this house with glory,’ says the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: I will shake all nations, and what is desired by all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory,’ says the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华说："银子是我的，金子也是我的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华说："银子是我的，金子也是我的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说：「银子是我的，金子也是我的。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘The silver is mine and the gold is mine,’ declares the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, declares the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine,’ says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The silver is Mine and the gold is Mine,’ declares the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: ‘The silver is mine and the gold is mine,’ declares the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华说："这殿宇后来的荣耀，必大过先前的荣耀。"万军之耶和华说："在这地方，我必赐下平安。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华说："这殿宇后来的荣耀，必大过先前的荣耀。"万军之耶和华说："在这地方，我必赐下平安。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这殿后来的荣耀必大过先前的荣耀；在这地方我必赐平安。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘The glory of this present house will be greater than the glory of the former house,’ says the Lord Almighty. ‘And in this place I will grant peace,’ declares the Lord Almighty."
verses.textEnEsv: The latter glory of this house shall be greater than the former, says the Lord of hosts. And in this place I will give peace, declares the Lord of hosts.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘The glory of this latter temple shall be greater than the former,’ says the Lord of hosts. ‘And in this place I will give peace,’ says the Lord of hosts."
verses.textEnNlt: The future glory of this Temple will be greater than its past glory, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. And in this place I will bring peace. I, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the Lord of armies, ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ declares the Lord of armies."
verses.textEn: ‘The glory of this present house will be greater than the glory of the former house,’ says the Lord Almighty. ‘And in this place I will grant peace,’ declares the Lord Almighty."

verses.textZh: 大利乌王第二年九月二十四日，耶和华的话临到哈该先知说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 大利乌王第二年九月二十四日，耶和华的话临到哈该先知说：
verses.textZhCuv: 大流士王第二年九月二十四日，耶和华的话临到先知哈该说：
verses.textEnNiv: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Haggai:
verses.textEnEsv: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet,
verses.textEnNkjv: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: On December 18 of the second year of King Darius’s reign, the Lord sent this message to the prophet Haggai:
verses.textEnNasb: On the twenty-fourth of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.textEn: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to the prophet Haggai:

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：你要向祭司询问有关律法的事说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：你要向祭司询问有关律法的事说：
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你要向祭司问律法，
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Ask the priests what the law says:
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: Ask the priests about the law:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Now, ask the priests concerningthe law, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says. Ask the priests this question about the law:
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord of armies says this: ‘Now ask the priests for a ruling:
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘Ask the priests what the law says:

verses.textZh: 人若用自己的衣襟盛载圣肉，后来又使自己的衣襟触着饼、汤、酒、油或别的食物，这就算为圣吗？"祭司都回答说："不算为圣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若用自己的衣襟盛载圣肉，后来又使自己的衣襟触着饼、汤、酒、油或别的食物，这就算为圣吗？"祭司都回答说："不算为圣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：若有人用衣襟兜圣肉，这衣襟挨着饼，或汤，或酒，或油，或别的食物，便算为圣吗？」祭司说：「不算为圣。」
verses.textEnNiv: If someone carries consecrated meat in the fold of their garment, and that fold touches some bread or stew, some wine, olive oil or other food, does it become consecrated?’ " The priests answered, "No."
verses.textEnEsv: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment and touches with his fold bread or stew or wine or oil or any kind of food, does it become holy?’" The priests answered and said, "No."
verses.textEnNkjv: "If one carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with the edge he touches bread or stew, wine or oil, or any food, will it become holy?" ’ " Then the priests answered and said, "No."
verses.textEnNlt: ‘If one of you is carrying some meat from a holy sacrifice in his robes and his robe happens to brush against some bread or stew, wine or olive oil, or any other kind of food, will it also become holy?’" The priests replied, "No."
verses.textEnNasb: If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and touches bread with this fold, or touches cooked food, wine, oil, or any other food, will it become holy?’ " And the priests answered, "No."
verses.textEn: If someone carries consecrated meat in the fold of their garment, and that fold touches some bread or stew, some wine, olive oil or other food, does it become consecrated?’ " The priests answered, "No."

verses.textZh: 哈该又说："人若因触着尸体而成为不洁，又触着这些东西的任何一样，这就算为不洁吗？"祭司都回答说："要算为不洁净。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈该又说："人若因触着尸体而成为不洁，又触着这些东西的任何一样，这就算为不洁吗？"祭司都回答说："要算为不洁净。"
verses.textZhCuv: 哈该又说：「若有人因摸死尸染了污秽，然后挨着这些物的哪一样，这物算污秽吗？」祭司说：「必算污秽。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Haggai said, "If a person defiled by contact with a dead body touches one of these things, does it become defiled?" "Yes," the priests replied, "it becomes defiled."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Haggai said, "If someone who is unclean by contact with a dead body touches any of these, does it become unclean?" The priests answered and said, "It does become unclean."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Haggai said, "If onewhois unclean because of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?" So the priests answered and said, "It shall be unclean."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Haggai asked, "If someone becomes ceremonially unclean by touching a dead person and then touches any of these foods, will the food be defiled?" And the priests answered, "Yes."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Haggai said, "If one who is unclean from a corpse touches any of these things, will the latter become unclean?" And the priests answered, "It will become unclean."
verses.textEn: Then Haggai said, "If a person defiled by contact with a dead body touches one of these things, does it become defiled?" "Yes," the priests replied, "it becomes defiled."

verses.textZh: 于是哈该回答，说："耶和华说：‘这民也是这样，这国在我面前也是这样；他们手里的一切工作，都是这样；他们在那里所献的，都是不洁净的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是哈该回答，说："耶和华说：‘这民也是这样，这国在我面前也是这样；他们手里的一切工作，都是这样；他们在那里所献的，都是不洁净的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 于是哈该说：「耶和华说：这民这国，在我面前也是如此；他们手下的各样工作都是如此；他们在坛上所献的也是如此。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Haggai said, " ‘So it is with this people and this nation in my sight,’ declares the Lord . ‘Whatever they do and whatever they offer there is defiled.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Haggai answered and said, "So is it with this people, and with this nation before me, declares the Lord , and so with every work of their hands. And what they offer there is unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Haggai answered and said, " ‘So is this people, and so is this nation before Me,’ says the Lord, ‘and so is every work of their hands; and what they offer there is unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Haggai responded, "That is how it is with this people and this nation, says the Lord . Everything they do and everything they offer is defiled by their sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Haggai responded and said, " ‘So is this people. And so is this nation before Me,’ declares the Lord, ‘and so is every work of their hands; and what they offer there is unclean.
verses.textEn: Then Haggai said, " ‘So it is with this people and this nation in my sight,’ declares the Lord . ‘Whatever they do and whatever they offer there is defiled.

verses.textZh: "现在你们要反省，从今日起回想过往，就是在耶和华的殿还没有一块石头叠在另一块石头上面以前，
verses.textZhCnvs: "现在你们要反省，从今日起回想过往，就是在耶和华的殿还没有一块石头叠在另一块石头上面以前，
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们要追想，此日以前，耶和华的殿没有一块石头垒在石头上的光景。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Now give careful thought to this from this day on —consider how things were before one stone was laid on another in the Lord ’s temple.
verses.textEnEsv: Now then, consider from this day onward. Before stone was placed upon stone in the temple of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And now, carefully consider from this day forward: from before stone was laid upon stone in the temple of the Lord—
verses.textEnNlt: Look at what was happening to you before you began to lay the foundation of the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: But now, do consider from this day onward: before one stone was placed on another in the temple of the Lord,
verses.textEn: " ‘Now give careful thought to this from this day on —consider how things were before one stone was laid on another in the Lord ’s temple.

verses.textZh: 那时你们怎样呢？有人到谷堆来，想得两百公斤谷，却只得一百公斤；有人到榨酒池去，想从酒槽得一百公升酒，却只得四十公升。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时你们怎样呢？有人到谷堆来，想得两百公斤谷，却只得一百公斤；有人到榨酒池去，想从酒槽得一百公升酒，却只得四十公升。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那一切日子，有人来到谷堆，想得二十斗，只得了十斗。有人来到酒池，想得五十桶，只得了二十桶。
verses.textEnNiv: When anyone came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When anyone went to a wine vat to draw fifty measures, there were only twenty.
verses.textEnEsv: how did you fare? When one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were but ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw fifty measures, there were but twenty.
verses.textEnNkjv: since those days, when one came to a heap of twenty ephahs, there were but ten; when one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty baths from the press, there were but twenty.
verses.textEnNlt: When you hoped for a twenty-bushel crop, you harvested only ten. When you expected to draw fifty gallons from the winepress, you found only twenty.
verses.textEnNasb: from that time when one came to a grain heap of twenty measures, there would be only ten; and when one came to the wine vat to draw fifty measures, there would be only twenty.
verses.textEn: When anyone came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When anyone went to a wine vat to draw fifty measures, there were only twenty.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说：‘我用旱风、霉烂和冰雹击打你们，和你们手里的一切工作，你们还是不归向我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说：‘我用旱风、霉烂和冰雹击打你们，和你们手里的一切工作，你们还是不归向我。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你们手下的各样工作上，我以旱风、霉烂、冰雹攻击你们，你们仍不归向我。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I struck all the work of your hands with blight, mildew and hail, yet you did not return to me,’ declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I struck you and all the products of your toil with blight and with mildew and with hail, yet you did not turn to me, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I struck you with blight and mildew and hail in all the labors of your hands; yet you did not turn to Me,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I sent blight and mildew and hail to destroy everything you worked so hard to produce. Even so, you refused to return to me, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: I struck you and every work of your hands with scorching wind, mildew, and hail; yet you did not come back to Me,’ declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: I struck all the work of your hands with blight, mildew and hail, yet you did not return to me,’ declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要反省，从今日起回想过往，就是自九月二十四日起，从耶和华殿的奠基日开始，你们要反省：
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要反省，从今日起回想过往，就是自九月二十四日起，从耶和华殿的奠基日开始，你们要反省：
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要追想此日以前，就是从这九月二十四日起，追想到立耶和华殿根基的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘From this day on, from this twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, give careful thought to the day when the foundation of the Lord ’s temple was laid. Give careful thought:
verses.textEnEsv: Consider from this day onward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month. Since the day that the foundation of the Lord ’s temple was laid, consider:
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Consider now from this day forward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, from the day that the foundation of the Lord’s temple was laid—consider it:
verses.textEnNlt: "Think about this eighteenth day of December, the day when the foundation of the Lord ’s Temple was laid. Think carefully.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Do consider from this day onward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month; from the day when the temple of the Lord was founded, consider:
verses.textEn: ‘From this day on, from this twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, give careful thought to the day when the foundation of the Lord ’s temple was laid. Give careful thought:

verses.textZh: 仓里还有种子吗？葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树和橄榄树，岂是还没有结果子吗？从今日起，我必赐福。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 仓里还有种子吗？葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树和橄榄树，岂是还没有结果子吗？从今日起，我必赐福。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 仓里有谷种吗？葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树、橄榄树都没有结果子。从今日起，我必赐福与你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Is there yet any seed left in the barn? Until now, the vine and the fig tree, the pomegranate and the olive tree have not borne fruit. " ‘From this day on I will bless you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Is the seed yet in the barn? Indeed, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have yielded nothing. But from this day on I will bless you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Is the seed still in the barn? As yet the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yielded fruit. But from this day I will bless you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I am giving you a promise now while the seed is still in the barn. You have not yet harvested your grain, and your grapevines, fig trees, pomegranates, and olive trees have not yet produced their crops. But from this day onward I will bless you."
verses.textEnNasb: Is the seed still in the barn? Even including the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree, it has not produced fruit. Yet from this day on I will bless you.’ "
verses.textEn: Is there yet any seed left in the barn? Until now, the vine and the fig tree, the pomegranate and the olive tree have not borne fruit. " ‘From this day on I will bless you.’ "

verses.textZh: 同月二十四日，耶和华的话再次临到哈该，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 同月二十四日，耶和华的话再次临到哈该，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 这月二十四日，耶和华的话二次临到哈该说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to Haggai a second time on the twenty-fourth day of the month:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came a second time to Haggai on the twenty-fourth day of the month,
verses.textEnNkjv: And again the word of the Lord came to Haggai on the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: On that same day, December 18, the Lord sent this second message to Haggai:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came a second time to Haggai on the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to Haggai a second time on the twenty-fourth day of the month:

verses.textZh: "你要向犹大省长所罗巴伯说：‘我要震动天地，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要向犹大省长所罗巴伯说：‘我要震动天地，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要告诉犹大省长所罗巴伯说：我必震动天地。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: "Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I am about to shake the heavens and the earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying: ‘I will shake heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah, that I am about to shake the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to Zerubbabel governor of Judah, saying, ‘I am going to shake the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEn: "Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth.

verses.textZh: 我必倾覆列国的宝座，消灭外族万国的势力，我必推翻战车和驾车的人；马匹和骑马的都必跌倒；各人必死在自己兄弟的刀下。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必倾覆列国的宝座，消灭外族万国的势力，我必推翻战车和驾车的人；马匹和骑马的都必跌倒；各人必死在自己兄弟的刀下。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我必倾覆列国的宝座，除灭列邦的势力，并倾覆战车和坐在其上的。马必跌倒，骑马的败落，各人被弟兄的刀所杀。
verses.textEnNiv: I will overturn royal thrones and shatter the power of the foreign kingdoms. I will overthrow chariots and their drivers; horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.
verses.textEnEsv: and to overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I am about to destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations, and overthrow the chariots and their riders. And the horses and their riders shall go down, every one by the sword of his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms; I will destroy the strength of the Gentile kingdoms. I will overthrow the chariots And those who ride in them; The horses and their riders shall come down, Every one by the sword of his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: I will overthrow royal thrones and destroy the power of foreign kingdoms. I will overturn their chariots and riders. The horses will fall, and their riders will kill each other.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will overthrow the thrones of kingdoms and destroy the power of the kingdoms of the nations; and I will overthrow the chariots and their riders, and the horses and their riders will go down, every one by the sword of another.’
verses.textEn: I will overturn royal thrones and shatter the power of the foreign kingdoms. I will overthrow chariots and their drivers; horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华说：‘撒拉铁的儿子，我的仆人所罗巴伯啊！到那日我必提拔你。’耶和华说：‘我必以你为印记。’万军之耶和华说：‘因为我拣选了你。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华说：‘撒拉铁的儿子，我的仆人所罗巴伯啊！到那日我必提拔你。’耶和华说：‘我必以你为印记。’万军之耶和华说：‘因为我拣选了你。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说：我仆人撒拉铁的儿子所罗巴伯啊，到那日，我必以你为印，因我拣选了你。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘On that day,’ declares the Lord Almighty, ‘I will take you, my servant Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel,’ declares the Lord , ‘and I will make you like my signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ declares the Lord Almighty."
verses.textEnEsv: On that day, declares the Lord of hosts, I will take you, O Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel, declares the Lord , and make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you, declares the Lord of hosts."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘In that day,’ says the Lord of hosts, ‘I will take you, Zerubbabel My servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says the Lord, ‘and will make you like a signet ring; for I have chosen you,’ says the Lord of hosts."
verses.textEnNlt: "But when this happens, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, I will honor you, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, my servant. I will make you like a signet ring on my finger, says the Lord , for I have chosen you. I, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘On that day,’ declares the Lord of armies, ‘I will take you, Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, My servant,’ declares the Lord, ‘and I will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ " declares the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: " ‘On that day,’ declares the Lord Almighty, ‘I will take you, my servant Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel,’ declares the Lord , ‘and I will make you like my signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ declares the Lord Almighty."
